questionPico.population: 连续用药三个月（≥12周）的气滞血瘀型冠心病/心绞痛患者
questionPico.intervention: 速效救心丸（含川芎、冰片）口服
questionPico.outcome: 长期有效性与长期安全性

claims.claim: 2018年Meta分析纳入41项随机对照试验、6276例冠心病患者
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: Forty-one trials involving 6276 patients were included in our analysis.
claims.uncertainty: 纳入试验多低Jadad分、未报告疗程与随访时长

pico.outcome: 心电图、血脂、血液流变学

claims.claim: 速效救心丸组心电图改善优于对照（RR 1.32，95% CI 1.26 to 1.38）
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: Pooled analysis indicated significant benefits of suxiao jiuxin pill on ECG outcomes (RR 1.32; 95% CI 1.26 to 1.38, P < 0.001).

claims.claim: 速效救心丸组总胆固醇（WMD -0.62 mmol/L）、低密度脂蛋白（WMD -1.12 mmol/L）下降，高密度脂蛋白（WMD 0.32 mmol/L）升高
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: Significant lower total cholesterol levels were reported in the suxiao jiuxin pill group compared with the control group (WMD −0.62 mmol/L, 95% CI −1.06 to –0.18 mmol/L, and P = 0.005). … There were significantly lower LDL levels in the treatment group compared with the control group (WMD −1.12 mmol/L, 95% CI −1.42 to −0.82 mmol/L, and P < 0.001) … There were significantly higher HDL levels in the treatment group compared with the control group (WMD 0.32 mmol/L, 95% CI 0.07 to 0.58 mmol/L, and P = 0.014).
claims.uncertainty: 仅4项试验报告血脂；异质性高

claims.claim: 2018年Meta分析中14项试验报告不良反应，最常见的为轻度头痛、头晕与面部潮红，多自行缓解
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: Fourteen studies reported the incidence of adverse reactions. The most common symptoms were mild headache, dizziness, and facial flushing. Most of these symptoms resolved spontaneously.
claims.applicability: 冠心病患者（多数短期疗程）
claims.uncertainty: 附带记录，多数疗程短；未报告停药比例

claims.claim: 不良反应发生率与对照组无显著差异（RR 1.12，95% CI 0.50 to 2.51）
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: There was no significant difference in the adverse reaction rates between the treatment and the control groups (RR 1.12, 95% CI 0.50 to 2.51, and P = 0.785)
claims.uncertainty: 附带记录，非以安全性为目的的研究

claims.claim: 纳入试验多因缺乏双盲而Jadad评分偏低
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: The majority of the included studies received low Jadad scores due to the lack of a double-blind design
claims.uncertainty: RoB 2 层面属高偏倚风险

claims.claim: 2018年Meta分析未分析心血管死亡与药物相关并发症
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: In this study, we did not analyze cardiovascular death or drug-related complications.

claims.claim: 试验方案纳入324例慢性稳定型心绞痛（气滞血瘀证）患者，疗程24周
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill in the treatment of stable angina (Qi stagnation and blood stasis syndrome): study protocol
claims.supportQuote: The trial will enroll 324 participants with chronic stable angina (Qi Stagnation and Blood Stasis syndrome). … Eligible participants will receive either SJP or placebo (five pills administered orally, three times daily) in addition to conventional treatment for 24 weeks.
claims.applicability: 气滞血瘀型慢性稳定型心绞痛
claims.uncertainty: 方案层级，已发表结果摘要未核对

pico.population: 慢性稳定型心绞痛（气滞血瘀证）

claims.claim: 给药方案为每次五粒、每日三次，在常规治疗基础上加用 24 周
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill in the treatment of stable angina (Qi stagnation and blood stasis syndrome): study protocol
claims.supportQuote: Eligible participants will receive either SJP or placebo (five pills administered orally, three times daily) in addition to conventional treatment for 24 weeks.
claims.applicability: 气滞血瘀型慢性稳定型心绞痛

claims.claim: 方案摘要将症状改善率与主要不良心血管事件并列为主要终点
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill in the treatment of stable angina (Qi stagnation and blood stasis syndrome): study protocol
claims.supportQuote: The primary outcomes are the symptom improvement rate of angina from baseline to 4 weeks after inclusion and major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE).
claims.uncertainty: 方案正文将主要终点定义为心血管事件复合终点，与摘要表述不一致

claims.claim: 次要终点包括心绞痛分级（CCS）、中医证候改善、西雅图心绞痛量表评分、急救药物用量与停药率、心电图疗效
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill in the treatment of stable angina (Qi stagnation and blood stasis syndrome): study protocol
claims.supportQuote: The secondary outcomes are angina classification (CCS), improvement of traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) syndromes, Seattle Angina Scale score, the dosage of emergency drugs and the stopping rate, and electrocardiogram (EKG) efficacy.
claims.uncertainty: 方案层级；运动耐量未列为主要或次要终点

claims.claim: 试验为前瞻性、随机、双盲、安慰剂对照、多中心设计
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill in the treatment of stable angina (Qi stagnation and blood stasis syndrome): study protocol
claims.supportQuote: This is a prospective, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, and multicenter trial.

claims.claim: 实验室监测包括血尿常规、肝肾功能评估与心电图
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill in the treatment of stable angina (Qi stagnation and blood stasis syndrome): study protocol
claims.supportQuote: Laboratory measurements will include a routine blood and urine test, hepatorenal assessment, and electrocardiogram
claims.uncertainty: 方案层级；已发表结果是否报告肝肾功能变化未核对

claims.claim: 川芎（川芎嗪）具有抑制血小板聚集的药理作用
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: Recent evidence has suggested that L. chuanxiong may exert antiplatelet effects by inhibiting the vWF-mediated process of platelet thrombus formation.
claims.uncertainty: 机制推断，非临床出血结局证据
